intent: A player whose bomb chain reaches 3 or more earns a 1.5x score multiplier for 10 seconds, shown to everyone as a glowing ring around that player; a later short chain or the timeout ends it.
accept: Finishing a chain of 3+ bombs gives that player a 1.5x score multiplier on knockouts for 10 seconds
A glowing ring is visible around the multiplier holder while it is active
The multiplier ends after 10 seconds or when the player's next chain is shorter than 3
Tests show a knockout scoring 1.5x during the multiplier and 1x after it ends

criteria.text: Finishing a chain of 3+ bombs gives that player a 1.5x score multiplier on knockouts for 10 seconds
criteria.evidence: rules.ts explodeBombs sets mult=chainMultTicks when n>=3, knockOut multiplies by chainMultFactor; test 'a chain of 3 sets the multiplier and its knockout scores 1.5x'. No after shot shows it happening (all chains are '1 chain').

criteria.text: A glowing ring is visible around the multiplier holder while it is active
criteria.evidence: assets.ts drawPlayer draws a yellow ring plus glow when mult>0 (code looks right, drawn after the dead early-return), but after/shot-1..3 show no ring on any player; only 1-chain popups occur. Not demonstrated visually, so not counted as met. The yellow ring is also close to the existing gold crown/

criteria.text: The multiplier ends after 10 seconds or when the player's next chain is shorter than 3
criteria.evidence: tests 'expires after chainMultTicks ticks; later knockouts score 1x' and 'a later chain under 3 clears the multiplier'; rules.ts decrements mult each tick and resets it per chain.

criteria.text: Tests show a knockout scoring 1.5x during the multiplier and 1x after it ends
criteria.evidence: rules.test.ts chain multiplier describe block: score 1.5 during, score delta 1 after expiry.

findings: The preview scenario never produces a 3+ chain, so before and after clips look identical: the viewer cannot see the feature. Make the effect reachable and obvious in the first minute: in rules.ts botInput let bots deliberately line up/trigger chains (or lower config.chainMultMinChain to 2 in config.ts) so a ring appears in the sampled scenario.

Ring is only a thin 3px yellow circle at r+9, similar in colour to the crown and pickups. In assets.ts drawPlayer make it larger and distinct (e.g. thicker, orange/magenta, rotating dashes or a 'x1.5' label above the player via nameStyle/text) so it is readable on a phone.

The multiplier effect is invisible in the score: scores are small numbers (1 vs 1.5) shown as integers in the leaderboard (e.g. '2'). Show a popup like '+1.5' or 'x1.5' on a multiplier knockout in assets.ts so players notice the gain.
